skill.name: documentation
skill.description: Enforces documentation standards, structure, and maintenance workflows for project documentation. It helps create, update, search, split, and consolidate markdown documentation while keeping files organized and consistent.
skill.summary: Create and maintain structured project documentation with reusable templates, rules, and helper workflows.
skill.author: DaoThiHuong2111

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown fences, inline-code backticks, placeholder relative links, Mermaid diagrams, and documented example paths. The real security-relevant surface is the bundled Bash helper scripts, which can execute locally and modify caller-supplied documentation files; no prompt injection attempt or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Bundled Bash scripts can modify caller-supplied paths.
remediation.suggestion: Add path validation or clear usage guidance that limits script targets to the project documentation directory, and consider backups before overwriting files.

remediation.issue: Shell helper scripts are included in a documentation skill.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running helper scripts and document exactly which scripts read, write, or delete content.

remediation.issue: Markdown examples trigger many security scanner false positives.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify in templates that relative links and hidden-path examples are placeholders or examples, not instructions to access sensitive files.

content.value_statement: Project documentation becomes hard to find when files grow, duplicate, or use different structures. This skill gives Claude Code, Claude, and Codex a consistent workflow for writing, updating, and organizing markdown documentation.
actual_capabilities: Searches existing markdown documentation before creating new files.
Applies screen, guide, and architecture templates for consistent structure.
Uses section-level helper scripts to inspect or update parts of large documents.
Checks documentation against rules for size, duplication, links, and code references.
Guides workflows for creating, updating, splitting, and consolidating documentation.
Supports screen-based organization with required overview and technical files.
limitations: Designed for markdown documentation in projects that follow its directory conventions.
Helper scripts require a shell environment and direct filesystem access.
It does not verify that code examples compile or run unless the user asks for testing.
It may need user guidance when documentation could belong in more than one section.

use_cases.title: Create screen documentation
use_cases.description: Generate a screen README and technical notes that follow the project template and required sections.

use_cases.title: Update existing developer docs
use_cases.description: Find the right document section, update only the relevant content, and preserve the existing file structure.

use_cases.title: Reduce documentation drift
use_cases.description: Find duplicate or oversized documentation and guide consolidation into focused markdown files.

prompt_templates.title: Find existing documentation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search before writing new docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the documentation skill to find existing docs about this feature before creating anything new: [feature or topic].

prompt_templates.title: Create a new screen document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create screen documentation for [screen name]. Follow the screen README and technical templates, and ask before creating duplicate files.

prompt_templates.title: Update a specific section
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the [section name] section in [document path] to reflect these changes: [change summary]. Keep the file under the documentation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Consolidate duplicate docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit docs for duplicate coverage of [topic]. Recommend what to merge, what to delete, and which file should become the source of truth.

output_examples.input: Create docs for the Settings screen.
output: Found no existing Settings screen documentation.
Created a screen overview with purpose, navigation, features, and related links.
Created technical notes with component references, state flow, and integration points.

output_examples.input: Update the authentication guide with the new login flow.
output: Located the current authentication guide and listed its sections.
Updated only the login flow section.
Kept existing headings, links, and document scope intact.

output_examples.input: Check whether we have duplicate onboarding docs.
output: Identified overlapping onboarding content in two guide files.
Recommended one source document and one redirecting reference.
Listed sections that should be merged before deletion.

best_practices: Search existing documentation before creating new files.
Keep each markdown file focused and below the documented size limit.
Include traceable code references when documentation describes implementation details.
anti_patterns: Creating a new document when an existing section should be updated.
Copying the same explanation into several files.
Adding untested examples or links without validation.

faq.question: What type of documentation does this skill create?
faq.answer: It focuses on markdown project documentation, including screen docs, guides, architecture notes, and workflow references.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude Code, Claude, and Codex as supported tools.

faq.question: Will it create files automatically?
faq.answer: It can create or update files when the user requests documentation changes and the selected tool has filesystem permission.

faq.question: How does it prevent duplicate documentation?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to search existing docs, inspect sections, and consolidate related content before creating new files.

faq.question: Does it validate links and examples?
faq.answer: It includes rules that require valid links and tested examples, but active validation depends on the user request and available tools.

faq.question: Is this skill project-specific?
faq.answer: Yes. It assumes a project documentation layout with guides, architecture notes, and screen-based documentation.
